name: CSS Unity
note: R13.3, Captain's Module J SSD p.2 (PDF p.3) - the Carriers & Escorts book, which is where this hull lives and why it is absent from C2 and R4; the owner added Module J to the project 2026-10-23 and the sheet was then validated box by box. The DREADNOUGHT's chassis turned carrier: shields 44/36/30/30/30/36 counted rather than assumed (#1 is two rows of three, sixteen rows of two, then two rows of three, which is 44), front and rear hull 16 each in 4x4 blocks, warp 24 a side in 8x3 blocks, impulse 4, APR 4, batteries 8, bridge 2, flag 2, emergency 2, aux 2, transporters 8, tractors 4, labs 4, one probe, turn mode E, size class 2, command rating 10. Crew 66 - six columns of ten and a seventh of six - boarding parties 20, DECK CREWS 24 for 24 fighters, the same one-to-one the CV and CVE keep. POINT VALUE = 245 is the FULLY REFITTED ship and WITHOUT PL-F REFIT (PRE Y179) = -16, so 229 is the Y176 hull: the same reading as the DN's 280 less 16 and the Star Cruiser's 185 less its four deductions. TWO BAYS, and the sheet says both of the things that matters about them in words - SHIP HAS TWO BAYS, NO TRANSFERS (J1.59) and EACH BAY HAS FOUR BALCONY (J1.53) POSITIONS. The balcony line is what justifies this hull's entry in BalconyPositionTest's roster, which is deliberately a roster so a human confirms the sheet grants one. J1.59's NO TRANSFERS is NOT modelled anywhere in the engine yet, and is recorded here because an unmodelled restriction reads exactly like one nobody noticed. Three admin shuttles per bay, not four: the table has six rows split three and three by its divider, which is also what makes each bay's fifteen boxes add up as twelve fighters plus three. Breakdown is printed as 3-6 and taken as 3, as the DN and DNT already do. The Y180 Sabot refit (+14) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 is in Module R10, out of scope.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet, verbatim: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE PLASMA-F TORPEDOES 'C,' 'D,' 'E,' 'F,' 'G,' 'H,' 'J,' AND 'K.' EIGHT, four a side, C-F to port and G-K to starboard, and the run SKIPS I as SSD letter runs always do. They start at C rather than E because on this hull A and B are the two PPDs - the Torpedo Dreadnought's eight run E to M for the same reason in reverse, its A-D being plasma-S, and an earlier draft of this file carried the DNT's letters by copy. R13.1C's rear-firing kind, flagged iscRearFiring, and the sheet cites R13.1C by name for the restrictions.
